title: Phase 1: clear the dead weight from Susi Core
goal: Phase 1 of Susi's foundation plan (decided 2026-11-22: 'why core and commercial still hold that many lines? this must be tackled now, before moving forward'). Remove from the tree what nothing in Susi Core reads, history keeping all of it: the pinned MCP specification copies under .agents/gmcp (they served a GMCP certification that left Susi on 2026-11-22), the catalogues under config/ecosystem (no code, test or script reads them), the CLI help snapshot fixture no test reads, and next the old records and the scripts no gate or hook runs. Documents that linked them point to the upstream specification instead. No test is weakened.

reuse.searched: Removes files; builds nothing. Looked at what reads each area: tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs (classifies .agents paths for its size report), build.rs, crates/*/src, src, scripts, .githooks, install.sh and every document linking .agents/gmcp/SPEC-PROVENANCE.md.
